name: U.S. Census Bureau · QuickFacts
vintage: V2025 population; 2020–2024 ACS households and income
method: Six manually reviewed county/parish records; exact page URLs retained per row.
rights: U.S. government statistical facts; source attribution retained.

name: New Orleans Pelicans · Official schedule
method: Extract upcoming New Orleans home games from the official page's structured schedule payload. Limited homepage coverage, not a full-season feed.
rights: Factual event metadata only; no photographs, logos, or editorial text redistributed.

name: Market comparison · SQL transformation
method: Income difference = 100 × (market income − Orleans income) / Orleans income. Growth difference = market population change − Orleans change, in percentage points.
rights: Project transformation; underlying Census facts attributed.

name: Campaign economics · Explicit assumptions
method: Inputs are editable demonstration assumptions, not team campaign results. All outputs are conditional on these inputs.

name: Saints + Pelicans · Official home schedules
vintage: Upcoming New Orleans home games, refreshed while the app is open
method: NBA structured schedule payload and Saints SportsEvent JSON-LD. Each selected event retains its exact official URL and retrieval time. Home games outside New Orleans are excluded.
rights: Factual event metadata; no team photography, logos, or editorial text redistributed.

name: ESPN · NBA and NFL scoreboard context
vintage: Current provider scoreboard window; last-checked time shown on each card
method: Fixed ESPN public scoreboard endpoints. Preserve scores and game state; missing values are unavailable. Source failures expose stale status. Scores do not drive campaign economics.
rights: Provider-owned factual game context with attribution. No ESPN media assets or broad redistribution license asserted.
